notes.title: Announcing the Go Go Electric Samurai 2v2 League!
notes.notes:
Announcing the Go Go Electric Samurai 2v2 League!

SIGN UP HERE: docs.google.com/forms/d/1pJd1XmjIQBtBtlToymBIjtJ3yok7LnjnotiI4t_CIQY/

Enter with your trusted teammate. Play for cash, points and prizes. It all leads up to the $1000 grand finale!

Each GGES League tournament will award $40 to the first place team and $20 to second place.

Even if you've never played before, the GGES League will give you plenty of opportunities to learn the ropes. Signups are free and open to everyone, so why not?

(What, are you afraid of exploding horribly in the vacuum of space? Don't be. It's quick and painless.)

Chat with the community + devs in our Discord Server: discord.gg/SW2ku9V

More Info: http://gogoelectricsamurai.ca/

notes.title: Update 0.94.1
notes.notes:
0.94.1 Changes
- Explodey stuff
- Unwelcome and Cognition Frame Drop Fix
- Increased Ball Speed EVEN MORE
- Scrollwheel adjusts camera distance
- Constrained mouse to screen properly
- Fullscreen scales
- Lobby wait when all is ready is now 3 seconds
- Invincibility respawn from shots
- Changed options from ESC key to O key
- Screenshot Key F1 is using Steam's screenshot features

0.94 Changes
- Training (Single Player Match)
- Faster Ball
- F2 and Options have a full screen option now
- Changed the maps screen a little
- Goals carried in are worth 2 points
- Lowered Braking Speed by 20%
- Added Players Online: info
- Added screenshot hot key F1
- Added ESC exits full screen
- Changed win/lose screen to say if you won/lost instead of which team won
